keyPoints.en: All living cells need energy for processes like muscle contraction, active transport, growth and nerve impulses.
keyPoints.bm: Semua sel hidup memerlukan tenaga untuk proses seperti pengecutan otot, pengangkutan aktif, pertumbuhan dan impuls saraf.

keyPoints.en: Cellular respiration oxidises glucose to release energy; part is stored as ATP, part lost as heat.
keyPoints.bm: Respirasi sel mengoksidakan glukosa untuk membebaskan tenaga; sebahagian disimpan sebagai ATP, sebahagian hilang sebagai haba.

keyPoints.en: ATP (adenosine triphosphate) → ADP + phosphate + energy. ATP is the cell's energy currency.
keyPoints.bm: ATP (adenosina trifosfat) → ADP + fosfat + tenaga. ATP ialah mata wang tenaga sel.

keyPoints.en: Two types: aerobic (with oxygen) and anaerobic/fermentation (without oxygen).
keyPoints.bm: Dua jenis: aerob (dengan oksigen) dan anaerob/fermentasi (tanpa oksigen).

question.en: Is breathing the same as respiration?

answer.en: No. Breathing moves air in and out of the lungs; cellular respiration is a chemical reaction in cells.
answer.bm: Tidak. Pernafasan menggerakkan udara masuk dan keluar paru-paru; respirasi sel ialah tindak balas kimia dalam sel.

tip.en: Never write 'respiration produces energy' — energy is RELEASED, not made.
tip.bm: Jangan tulis 'respirasi menghasilkan tenaga' — tenaga DIBEBASKAN, bukan dihasilkan.

keyPoints.en: Glycolysis (glucose → pyruvate) happens in the cytoplasm; the rest occurs in mitochondria.
keyPoints.bm: Glikolisis (glukosa → piruvat) berlaku dalam sitoplasma; selebihnya dalam mitokondria.

keyPoints.en: Glucose is completely broken down, so a lot of energy is released (~38 ATP per glucose).
keyPoints.bm: Glukosa diuraikan sepenuhnya, jadi banyak tenaga dibebaskan (~38 ATP per glukosa).

keyPoints.en: Experiment: limewater turns chalky with CO₂ from respiring seeds/insects; soda lime absorbs CO₂ in respirometers.
keyPoints.bm: Eksperimen: air kapur menjadi keruh dengan CO₂ daripada biji benih/serangga yang berespirasi; soda kapur menyerap CO₂ dalam respirometer.

question.en: In a respirometer with soda lime, the coloured liquid moves towards the germinating seeds. Why?
question.bm: Dalam respirometer dengan soda kapur, cecair berwarna bergerak ke arah biji benih bercambah. Mengapa?

answer.en: Seeds use O₂; the CO₂ released is absorbed by soda lime, so the gas volume and pressure fall.
answer.bm: Biji benih menggunakan O₂; CO₂ yang dibebaskan diserap soda kapur, jadi isi padu dan tekanan gas berkurang.

tip.en: Use boiled (dead) seeds as the control set-up.
tip.bm: Guna biji benih rebus (mati) sebagai susunan kawalan.

keyPoints.en: Fermentation: incomplete breakdown of glucose without oxygen, in the cytoplasm; releases little energy (2 ATP).
keyPoints.bm: Fermentasi: penguraian glukosa tidak lengkap tanpa oksigen, dalam sitoplasma; membebaskan sedikit tenaga (2 ATP).

keyPoints.en: In muscles during vigorous exercise: glucose → lactic acid + 150 kJ. Lactic acid causes fatigue and cramps.
keyPoints.bm: Dalam otot semasa senaman cergas: glukosa → asid laktik + 150 kJ. Asid laktik menyebabkan lesu dan kekejangan.

keyPoints.en: Oxygen debt is repaid after exercise: lactic acid goes to the liver and is oxidised or converted back to glucose.
keyPoints.bm: Hutang oksigen dibayar selepas senaman: asid laktik dibawa ke hati dan dioksidakan atau ditukar semula kepada glukosa.

keyPoints.en: In yeast: glucose → ethanol + CO₂ + 210 kJ — used for bread, tapai and biofuel.
keyPoints.bm: Dalam yis: glukosa → etanol + CO₂ + 210 kJ — digunakan untuk roti, tapai dan bahan api bio.

keyPoints.en: Lactic acid bacteria make yogurt and cheese; fermentation also makes tempeh, budu and cincalok.
keyPoints.bm: Bakteria asid laktik menghasilkan yogurt dan keju; fermentasi juga menghasilkan tempe, budu dan cincalok.

question.en: Why are athletes advised to cool down slowly after a race?
question.bm: Mengapa atlet dinasihatkan melakukan aktiviti menyejukkan badan perlahan-lahan selepas perlumbaan?

answer.en: Continued blood flow and breathing help remove lactic acid and repay the oxygen debt.
answer.bm: Aliran darah dan pernafasan yang berterusan membantu menyingkir asid laktik dan membayar hutang oksigen.

tip.en: Human fermentation makes NO carbon dioxide — only yeast fermentation does.
tip.bm: Fermentasi manusia TIDAK menghasilkan karbon dioksida — hanya fermentasi yis.
